title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: timespace
text:
time/space complexity
time/space complexity
(definition)
Definition:
The maximum time or space required by a
Turing machine
on any input of length n.
See also
time-constructible function
,
space-constructible function
.
Note:
